about: Hand-kept calendar for the Performance Marketeer (2026-04-01 → 2027-12-31). Dates IST, New Delhi. verified=false rows are estimates — say so when using them. Re-check yearly.
rules: Salary-day effect: purchases and order values tend to rise on the 1st–5th of each month (salaried users), softer in the last week. Compare like-for-like days of month, not just week-on-week.
Festive season: Meta CPMs in India rise from ~1 week before Navratri through Diwali as e-commerce sales and brands compete; expect costs up even with unchanged creative.
Pitru Paksha / Kharmas / Adhik Maas: demand for auspicious or wish-fulfilment products dips; remedy/ancestor/dosh angles hold up better.
Eclipse visible in India: sutak day — auspicious purchases avoided; remedy and grahan content interest spikes.
